tasks.task: Build one app screen in React Native or Flutter

items.when: Before any code, to write what the screen shows when loading, empty, failed or offline
When a client needs a new screen taken all the way to a build testers can install
When you write the screen from a plain description and sample data, every state first
When the app is Expo and the screen needs native tabs, styling and motion in its router
When the screen is drafted, for a ready, fix-first or rethink call with ranked fixes
When the screen is crowded, to keep only what serves the one job it has

tasks.task: Plan screen states and rewrite error and empty messages

items.when: When a screen keeps drawing bug reports about spinners, blank pages or nothing happening
When you need the states people hit first listed for a screen nobody planned
When the app's screens and current text are shared and every message needs rewriting
When error lines blame the user or say nothing about what to do next
When buttons, toasts and hints need to be short and friendly

tasks.task: Fix a screen that crashes, hangs or looks wrong

items.when: When a user sends rough notes and a screenshot and personal details must be kept out
When you have the bug and the code near it and need suspects ranked with a check each
When the fault is a missing state or a layout that breaks on small or old phones
When the fix must come with the cause proven, a test and a pull request
When guesses pile up, to follow what the code really does on the device

tasks.task: Triage crash reports after a release

items.when: When crashes or Android vitals warnings pile up and you must pick which to fix first
When the app is Expo and you need crash rates and installs for each published update
When one crash has several possible causes worth checking side by side
When poor store reviews describe problems the crash reports do not show

tasks.task: Check and fix a screen for accessibility

items.when: When you need a test plan for screen readers and keyboards, not only a code read
When one screen must work with VoiceOver, TalkBack, large text and reduced motion
When the client asks which WCAG level the app meets and what a statement should say
Each quarter, to rank the gaps and confirm last quarter's fixes held

tasks.task: Plan a React Native, Expo or Flutter upgrade

items.when: When the app is behind and a store deadline or a dying library forces the move
When the app is Expo and you want the upgrade run and broken packages fixed
When one package is the risky part and needs stages with a test each
When the app should never fall this far behind again

tasks.task: Write component or widget tests for screens

items.when: Before writing tests, to list each state and action to cover, smallest first
When a screen has no tests and must be made safe to change
When tests are written with the screen, one for each state in the table
When the suite is red and you want capped rounds of fixes until green or stopped
When a screen seems too tangled to test, to take one small case at a time

tasks.task: Get an app version ready for the stores

items.when: When a version must meet build rules and have its privacy answers and notes drafted
When signing, a go or no-go list and rollout stages need planning
Before review, to see what in the design breaks Apple's rules
When the owner needs a clear go or no-go with the blockers listed

tasks.task: Release to the stores with a staged rollout

items.when: When a tested version is ready: a first launch, a big update or a store deadline
When the app is Expo and builds must be made and sent to both stores
When you need stage sizes and the health signals that pause the rollout
On release day, for checks, a way back and how to know it worked
Before release, to find test gaps and help pages the new version makes wrong

tasks.task: Draft the privacy label and Data safety answers

items.when: When nobody has mapped what personal data the app and its SDKs collect
When you need the full list of packages and SDKs in the app before answering
Before a first submission, after adding an SDK, or when a store flags a mismatch
When the store asks for a privacy policy link and there is none to send a lawyer

tasks.task: Write permission messages and decide when to ask

items.when: When the app asks for location, camera, photos, contacts, notifications or tracking
When the wording is drafted, to test it against the words users already say

tasks.task: Add data loading, caching and offline behaviour

items.when: When a React Native screen needs fetch, cache, retry and offline code
When edits made offline must merge later and the rules need planning
When calls fail on weak signal and need safe waiting and retrying
When the code is in, to confirm every offline and error state has a screen

tasks.task: Connect the app to a back end and sign-in

items.when: When the app uses Supabase and must connect with scoped access and safe keys
When an Expo app needs a few server routes of its own
When users sign in through another service and the right OAuth flow is needed
When keys may be sitting in the app bundle or the repository

tasks.task: Plan a paywall and upgrade screens

items.when: When the app has plans and needs upgrade screens, trigger moments and copy
When the purchase can fail, be pending or be restored and each needs a state

tasks.task: Automate builds and watch update health

items.when: When an Expo app should build on every push and make preview builds
When the app is not Expo and needs a pipeline file with test and build stages
After an update ships, to compare its crash rate and size with the last one

tasks.task: Run a beta and sort tester feedback

items.when: When the beta needs who to invite, what to ask and a rule for when it ends
When one feature goes to a beta with metrics set before it starts
When feedback from testers and reviews needs ranking into what users need
When feedback arrives every week and each request needs a yes, later or no

tasks.task: Write the What's New notes for a release

items.when: When you have the code history and need plain notes users can read
When users and the team each need the same update told their own way
Before submitting, to catch any line that claims a change the build does not have

tasks.task: Prepare the store listing and screenshots

items.when: When a listing exists and needs a scored audit and a rewritten title and description
When the running app needs sharp screenshots for the stores and social posts
When listing text must match what the build and the privacy answers say

tasks.task: Prepare an app for more than one language

items.when: When you need to find what breaks in other languages: plurals, dates and right-to-left
When text is hardcoded and needs moving to locale files with a plan
When strings are translated, to check meaning and that longer words still fit

tasks.task: Fix a slow or stuttering screen

items.when: When a screen feels slow and the bottleneck must be found, fixed and timed
When an animation stutters and each slow spot needs a small fix

tasks.task: Write or review native iOS screens

items.when: When iPhone screens must feel native and be checked on small and large sizes
When SwiftUI code needs review or a rewrite with current APIs
When the design must match Apple's rules before submission

tasks.task: Plan the app's analytics events

items.when: When the app needs an event list, naming rules and one main metric
When new tracking is added and the store privacy answers must change to match

tasks.task: Plan a small app before building it

items.when: When a small business wants an app and needs a build plan with device checks
When a React Native project needs a folder layout and rules for what imports what
When a working prototype must become an app real users can rely on

always.when: At the end of any coding job, to write what changed, why and which devices it was tried on

helpers.when: When the app needs endpoints, webhooks or payments built behind it
When there is no design and screens need one before they are built
When the listing, keywords and screenshots must win installs
When a release needs a test pass across devices and system versions
When the client needs a full audit and statement, not fixes to one screen
When the app stores secrets or handles payments and needs a security review

gaps: No library item writes a Flutter screen or Flutter widget tests; the library's mobile builders are Expo or React Native only
No library item writes React Native Testing Library tests or end-to-end tests with Maestro or Detox
No library item reads Crashlytics, Sentry or Android vitals output and ranks crashes; only the kit prompt does
No library item drafts Apple privacy labels or Google Data safety answers from an SDK list
No library item offers alternative permission wordings to compare, or checks them against store rules
No library item answers an App Store or Google Play rejection
No library item covers in-app purchases and subscriptions in code: StoreKit, Play Billing or RevenueCat
No library item sets up push notifications, deep links or universal links
No library item fixes slow lists, slow start-up or memory use on older Android phones
No library item writes or reviews Kotlin or Jetpack Compose code
No library item checks a mobile screen with VoiceOver or TalkBack; accessibility items are written for the web
No library item covers code signing, provisioning profiles and keystore set-up
